rating.$description: Rating icons. The value is carried by shape — a filled icon against an outlined one — and by the accessible name, never by hue alone. Component tokens reference semantic tokens through their CSS variables, so one declaration re-themes.

filled-edge.$description: The outline of a filled icon. The rating fill is a light gold that sits at ~1.7:1 on a light surface, so on its own a filled star has no edge a low-vision user can find; drawing it in the fill mixed toward the text colour gives a deep-gold edge at ≥3.4:1 on every light surface and a pale-gold one on dark, without changing the fill.
